rows.en: Touya: "...?"
Yamato: "Huh? There's no one here..."
Miyasco: "Touya! Everyone is installing the defensive field's
auxiliary output devices. For now,
we'll have to assign several mechs to maintain it.
I'm sorry, but please select the mechs that will take part in combat.
We'll take care of the rest here."
Touya: "O-Oh... Got it."
Touya: "Hey, wouldn't it be better to stay
inside the hangar until we've broken through?"
Arthur: "That is true, but we have to allow for the unexpected..."
Touya: "What do you mean?"
Clovis: "The hatch could be destroyed by shellfire,
or the hangar itself could take a hit. All sorts of things could happen, right?"
Xiujian: "More of us should survive until we make our entry
if we stay outside like this."
Fain: "I could accept being defeated in a clash of blades, but being destroyed
by shellfire or the like is something I'd rather be spared..."
Sisk: "Be careful! Vorlia's surface is showing
a high-temperature reading!"
Clovis: "...Looks like we're not welcome after all."
Sisk: "Here it comes!"
Touya: "Ghh... Please, hold out..."
Sisk: "Huh...? What's going on?"
Derock: "It's almost like a warning shot.
It didn't come our way, but if we took a hit like that,
we wouldn't stand a chance."
Celica: "Brother Rayfon!"
Rayfon: "We'll manage the defense on our end."
Rishuna: "Everyone, prepare to enter.
With our mechs, we can manage as long as we only have to block the attacks!"
Touya: "Thanks. Then we should be all right... Okay!"
Valga: "...It would seem it's not quite that simple."
Celica: "Huh? Wh-What... is that...?"
Clovis: "Those ones in the middle... Aren't they Parthenos and
Eleana?!"
Rayfon: "This is bad... It made replicas..."
Touya: "It can pull off something that ridiculous?!"
Valga: "It is doing so before our eyes. We can hardly deny it.
But that Vorlia is manifesting abilities
unknown to us. This is rather troublesome..."
Rayfon: "Don't worry. They're mere imitations. Their performance
should be inferior to the originals."
Celica: "Even if it is..."
Rayfon: "It seems it's realized what we're trying to do.
We've got our hands full defending. I'm leaving this to you."
Celica: "...We have no choice, then..."
Arthur: "We also have the battle inside to consider.
Rather than push ourselves, how about taking damaged mechs back aboard Liebhofen
for shelter?"
Ymir: "...Yes.
Any mech that reaches 80% damage is to withdraw.
We'll repair them as much as possible
and prepare to enter."
Ai: "Understood. But if it turns into 'Everyone, retreat!'
that won't be funny."
Kasumi: "Then let's all work together to make sure it doesn't, okay?"
Ai: "Well, that's worked for us so far,
so let's finish this in style."
Clovis: "...Touya, Rayblade is our command center, so to speak.
We need you to hold out to the end. Can you do it?"
Touya: "You can count on me."
Xiujian: "That's the answer I wanted.
...I'd say we have four minutes until we reach the designated point."
Touya: "All right, let's give it everything we've got to intercept them.
Protect Liebhofen!"
Yamato: "Three minutes left. Hang in there!"
Yamato: "Two minutes left! Just a little more... We're almost there..."
Yamato: "One minute left! One last push! We can do this!"
Sisk: "We've reached the designated point!"
Miyasco: "Output rising! We can do it!"
Touya: "Heh! Maybe I got a little too serious out there!"
Yamato: "Honestly! Don't let your guard down!
The real fight is just starting meow."
Touya: "Yeah, yeah."
Yamato: "Honestly..."
Sisk: "We've reached the designated point!"
Miyasco: "Output rising! We can do it!"
Sisk: "Second bulkhead damaged! Closing bulkheads!"
Captain Roa: "Hmm...!"
Derock: "Th-This is bad."
Sisk: "Floating Block System damaged!
Third bulkhead severely damaged! Sealing off everything through Area B!"
Miyasco: "If this keeps up..."
Sisk: "The engine room's been hit! We can't hold out any longer!"
Miyasco: "Please, hold together..."
Captain Roa: "H-Hmm..."
Yamato: "Touya!"
Touya: "Yeah... Two more hits and we're finished.
I'm not letting it get another shot in!"
Sisk: "Engine room severely damaged!
We won't close the bulkheads... in time!"
Miyasco: "Blocks 2, 4, 6 and 7 are silent!
N-No! The chain explosions... Aaaaaah!!"
Clovis: "Sorry, I'm withdrawing!"
Arthur: "This is as far as I can go...
I'm sorry. I'm counting on you to handle the rest!"
Fain: "Something this trivial...!"
Touya: "Fain! That's enough! Fall back!"
Fain: "Not yet! I can still fight!"
Touya: "I can't afford to lose you now!
Don't push yourself!"
Fain: "You can't...? I-I see.
Hehehehe, very well. I'm leaving the rest to you!
Next time, I shall win! Dahahaha!"
Touya: "..."
Xiujian: "...This is my limit... I'm leaving the rest to you."
Ai: "Ugh... I can't believe I let my guard down..."
Touya: "Ai, leave the rest to me."
Ai: "...This is frustrating... But there's nothing I can do.
...All right. I'm counting on you, then!"
Kasumi: "...If this keeps up... But...!"
Touya: "That's enough! There's no need to push yourself here."
Kasumi: "Touya-chan... But..."
Touya: "Trust me. I'll protect Liebhofen, no matter what.
So leave this to me."
Kasumi: "...Okay.
...Touya-chan, be careful."
Celica: "Hmm, with Selphin's armor,
a chaotic melee like this really does put me at a disadvantage...
Sorry, I'm counting on you to handle the rest!"
Aurelie: "Aagh, come on! Maybe I'm just
not cut out for defense after all!
...I don't have a choice. I'm pulling back!"
Kururu: "Eek!"
Touya: "Are you okay?"
Kururu: "Y-Yeah... Sorry, I'm falling back."
Melissa: "Ah... Is this as far as I can go?"
Touya: "Are you all right?"
Melissa: "Yes...
I'm sorry. I'm counting on you to handle the rest."

row_decisions.scenario.s_161.o006c1.l00: Derock says attack seems a warning and did not come toward them, not a confirmed intentional miss or proven immunity. Celica Brother Rayfon uses established sibling address.
row_decisions.scenario.s_161.o0082c.l00: Printed Parthenos and Eleana names remain on rows34/35; no unprinted Shadow suffix. Rayfon identifies replicas36 and predicts inferior performance41-42; not verified enemy statistics. Valga unfamiliar Vorlia abilities remains report.
row_decisions.scenario.s_161.o0092a.l00: Genuine trailing objection Even if it is retained as fragment, responding to predicted inferior performance. Rayfon leaves battle to companions while he handles defense45, not reversed help direction.
row_decisions.scenario.s_161.o009a6.l00: Damaged mechs return aboard Liebhofen; 80percent damage51 is withdrawal threshold, not80percent remaining HP. Next FE display page52-53 continues same Ymir quotation.
row_decisions.scenario.s_161.o00a52.l00: Everyone retreat wording is hypothetical undesirable outcome, not an actual command applying to every unit. Clovis59-60 asks Touya/Rayblade to hold out, Touya accepts61.
row_decisions.scenario.s_161.o00b38.l01: Countdown4/3/2/1 minutes stays same-row values; arrival/output lines69-70 and76-77 are separate event alternatives, not duplicate-count deletion.
row_decisions.scenario.s_161.o01071.l00: Second/third bulkhead, Floating Block System, Area B and blocks2/4/6/7 retained. Source major-damage wording not automatically ship destruction.
